name: Good-by to You
source:
Main character is a part-time detective. There is enough confidence in own powers, but case evolves in an unexpected and dangerous direction, so safety is no longer guaranteed.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名兼职侦探，对自己的能力颇有信心。然而，案件朝着出人意料且危险的方向发展，他的人身安全也不再有任何保障。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
